name: Samuel Bailey
strengths: Bailey drives nose tackles off the ball in duo and walls the playside gap with natural displacement at 6-5.5 / 300.
Bailey sinks and anchors vs bull rush at depth — functional mass stops forward momentum without giving the edge.
Bailey climbs and mirrors linebackers on wide-zone pulls, staying square and finishing through the whistle.
weaknesses: Bailey’s kick-slide can be late vs pure speed rush — edge runners who win the arc will punish slow first steps until hand timing tightens.
comparison: Bailey comps to Tristan Wirfs — 6-5 / 6-6 tackle mold with starter mass already on the frame and enough athleticism to mirror and finish in space.
projection: Bailey projects as a Year 2 SEC rotation OT (develop Year 1). Ceiling: multi-year SEC starter — the massive Jemison tackle who can grow into a cornerstone edge.
schemeFit: Bailey fits a power/zone hybrid tackle who can win with length and mass while cleaning up hand timing vs speed.
staffNotes: Vault film desk re-verified 2026-08-10 from On3 Hudl sophomore embed (updated from profile link). Comp size-matched to Tristan Wirfs mold — not a Florida-alum default.
insiderNotes: Bailey is a 6-5.5 / 300 tackle with natural power, anchor, and finish. Speed-rush first step is the growth item — the frame and run displacement are already starter-band. Florida has two strong visits and likes its position.
recruitingStory: Samuel Bailey is a 4-star OT · listed 6-5.5 / 300 · Jemison (Huntsville, AL) · ~Natl #49 — first full HS season 2025; two Gainesville visits; game return planned.
angle: Jemison OT tape: duo power + pass-set anchor + length; Florida priority with return visit heat.
